tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background: the warm linen every section sits on. Never swap it for white or grey.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, product tiles, inputs, the header. Lifted off the canvas by shadow-card, never by a border.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, the border on chips and secondary buttons, the header rule.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body text, nav, icons. Walnut, not black. 10:1 on canvas, 11.3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-deep
tokens.usage: Text on the accent (5.6:1) and the dark button fill. Also the footer and announcement bar ground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, captions, vendor names. 5.5:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Inactive dots, disabled fills, link underline at rest. Decorative only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Apricot clay, the ONE accent: primary buttons, the round submit, active dot, wordmark dot, badge Sale, brand-card hover glow. Fill only; never body text (3.0:1 on surface).

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Text selection, the footer wordmark dot on ink-deep, soft tint behind icons.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-deep. Dark, not white.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on ink-deep and ink (footer, announcement bar, the dark Tools tile).

tokens.name: slate-ink
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on the dark footer (social buttons).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a modal or the mobile menu.

tokens.name: photo-shade
tokens.usage: Flat shade over lifestyle photos so on-dark text reads. No gradients.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: One word over a dark product tile, or the hero wordmark. Drops to 56px on phones.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Spotlight beats and collection titles. 44px on phones.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Section openers (brands wall, editorial). 32px on phones.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Product page title, sign-up card title.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Section headers with the chevron, the Tools tile caption.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Professional hair care, nails, barber and tools. Open to everyone.
styles.usage: Intro lines and the product price.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Argan and linseed oils cleanse without stripping.
styles.usage: Running copy, inputs, chips. The floor for sentences.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Footer links, prices on cards, announcement text.

styles.name: ui-sm
styles.usage: Product names on cards, small buttons, footer column titles, category chip labels.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Vendor name on cards and the star rating. Never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The white frame around a product photo inside its card; gaps inside buttons.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards on phones; gap inside a card's text block.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card grid gap on desktop; card text padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page gutter on tablet; section header to grid.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; sign-up card padding.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Gap between homepage sections.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Gap before the Spotlight and editorial bands.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Every card, tile and the hero stage. The brand's rounding.

tokens.name: radius-image
tokens.usage: The photo inside a card, 8px in from the card edge, which leaves a white frame.

tokens.name: radius-brand
tokens.usage: Brand logo tiles and icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: The translucent label chip on category tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every control that sits inline with text: buttons, chips, search, dots, badges.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, secondary buttons, badges.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every elevated card. The dual soft shadow replaces borders.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Card hover, carousel arrows.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: Under the accent submit button and primary buttons, so the accent is in the elevation too.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Content container. The hero stage is 1120px inside it.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Sticky header on a 48px black announcement band.

tokens.name: hero-ratio
tokens.usage: Hero stage on desktop (4 / 3 on phones). Clips are 4:3, so they crop slightly top and bottom on desktop.
